description: This file declares an interface for a thread-safe logger that extends SLF4J's Logger. Its main feature is to facilitate setting, deriving, and discarding correlation IDs to be included in log entries via MDC, and it ensures thread safety. The interface provides methods to attach correlation IDs from various sources such as direct strings, headers, or header collections, and to remove them.

classes.name: ThreadSafeDittoLogger
classes.description: An interface extending SLF4J's Logger with additional thread-safe methods to manage correlation IDs attached to MDC for logging purposes.

methods.name: withCorrelationId
methods.description: Creates a new logger instance with the specified correlation ID attached to the MDC; null or empty disables correlation ID.

methods.name: withCorrelationId
methods.description: Derives a correlation ID from the provided WithDittoHeaders headers and returns a logger with this ID attached.

methods.name: withCorrelationId
methods.description: Extracts a correlation ID from the provided DittoHeaders and returns a logger with this ID attached.

methods.name: discardCorrelationId
methods.description: Removes any currently set correlation ID from the MDC, returning a logger instance that does not include a correlation ID.
